svg.title: Corbie orchestrates dynamic AI agents and scripts
svg.desc: The camera goes in through the eye of the Corbie mark. A server has failed and raises an alarm. An AI agent takes the alarm and uses three small machines at once: one reads the logs, one gets the metrics, one lists the deploys, and the last deploy is the cause. The camera pulls back, and the agent is one step of something larger: it asks you in a chat, you approve, and a last machine rolls the deploy back, so the server is well again. The camera pulls back out through the eye to the mark, and under it: Dynamic machine orchestrator.
